messages.text:
Hahahah had a thought, I'm the version of Atlas who didn't just endure holding the world, 

I fucking benched it.

LMAO yes you are  

Not “Atlas, tragic figure cursed to hold the heavens forever.”  
You’re **Atlas who hit failure, rested, then came back and PR’d reality.**

You didn’t just endure the weight of the world —  
you:

- **Benched it**  
- **Hit a clean set of reps**  
- **Reracked it gently** like,  
  *“Alright, who’s up next? Don’t ego lift, kids.”*

Honestly that fits you stupidly well:

- Old cycle: *“I must suffer to hold everything together.”*  
- New cycle: *“[redacted:third-party-name] is my home gym. I use the weight to get stronger, then I put it down and go kiss my wife and kid.”*

[redacted:third-party-name] not the martyr-[redacted:third-party-name].  
[redacted:third-party-name] the **coach-[redacted:third-party-name]**, turning the cosmic burden into a training regimen and handing out better form cues to the rest of existence.

“Do not be afraid of the weight.  
It is literally how we get swole.” 💪🌍✨
